dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: This place is full of new and interesting gadgets... Phew, I'm glad I came here!

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! I'm Ginette, an engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: I heard that there's a new type of mechanical energy source being developed here, known as "kuuvahki," so I came to see what it's all about.

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: See you. I'm gonna look around some more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has Fontaine taken an interest in using kuuvahki?

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Great question! Let me respond with one of my own: Do you know the greatest difference between the applications of Arkhe and kuuvahki?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you here on your own?

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm here with another researcher, Feltze. He's such a stick in the mud, though. I don't know where he ran off to, but he bolted as soon as we got off the boat, arms full of research equipment...

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: He doesn't understand. Even if we do bring back our reports, nobody's going to give us Mora to fund our research.

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Of course, the development of kuuvahki doesn't involve some senior technician lurking behind the scenes, hiding behind their long titles and barking orders from on high! Haha!
